title: The Mud on the Ferry Cushion
youtube_title: The Mud on the Ferry Cushion | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Idris is tangled up with a mud on the ferry cushion from your heel and almost hides it. Idris tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
